t: C-Deterministic Grand Unification: Theory Consistency Checker — Simple
name: C-Deterministic Grand Unification: Theory Consistency Checker — Simple
title: C-Deterministic Grand Unification: Theory Consistency Checker — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A checker that tests whether two theories can both be true: it formalizes their claims, searches for contradictions, and reports the overlap honestly. Unification without consistency checking is wishful thinking.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Relativity gamma at v=0.8c = 1.6667 factor. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: The C-Deterministic Grand Unification (CDGU) — Proving the Inviolable Constant Reality + God Does Not Play Dice with the Universe — C-Deterministic Unification of Relativity and Chance
real_world_basis: Formal consistency checking is standard in theoretical physics.
signature_version: Signature version: the unification checker — the chapter's inviolable reality as checked consistency, with the 'absolute' framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: formalize both theories first, check for contradiction, and publish the overlap map.
math_note: Relativity gamma at v=0.8c: 1.6667 factor [verified]; Quantum photon at 400 nm: 3.0996 eV [verified]
safety: Rigor safety: the checker reports contradictions; it must never be tuned to find unity.
how_it_works: Formalized theories feed the checker; contradictions report with the conflicting claims. The demo recomputes the gamma factor for the relativity side and the photon energy for the quantum side.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time
